API Details¶

a module for plotting the NeuroRA results

neurora.rsa_plot.plot_brainrsa_glass(img, threshold=0, nvoxels_threshold=None, vmin=None, vmax=None, cmap='hot', title='RSA Results', colorbar_label=None, black_bg=True, draw_cross=True, connectivity=1, show=True)¶

Plot a glass-brain projection of RSA results.

Parameters:

  • img (str or Niimg-like object) – NIfTI image of RSA results.

  • threshold (float or None, default=0) – Display threshold passed to nilearn plotting.

  • nvoxels_threshold (int or None, default=None) – Minimum cluster size in voxels.

  • vmin (float or None, default=None) – Color limits.

  • vmax (float or None, default=None) – Color limits.

  • cmap (str or matplotlib colormap, default="hot") – Colormap.

  • title (str or None, default="RSA Results") – Plot title.

  • colorbar_label (str or None, default=None) – Colorbar label.

  • black_bg (bool, default=True) – Whether to use a black background.

  • draw_cross (bool, default=True) – Whether to draw crosshair.

  • connectivity (int, default=1) – Connectivity used for cluster-size thresholding.

  • show (bool, default=True) – Whether to show the plot immediately.

Returns:

Nilearn display object.

Return type:

display

neurora.rsa_plot.plot_brainrsa_montage(img, threshold=0, nvoxels_threshold=None, cut_coords=(6, 6, 6), background='/Users/zitonglu/Documents/Projects/NeuroRA-master/neurora/template/ch2bet.nii.gz', vmin=None, vmax=None, cmap='hot', title='RSA Results', colorbar_label=None, draw_cross=True, connectivity=1, show=True)¶

Plot RSA results across sagittal, coronal, and axial cuts.

Parameters:

  • img (str or Niimg-like object) – NIfTI image of RSA results.

  • threshold (float or None, default=0) – Display threshold passed to nilearn plotting.

  • nvoxels_threshold (int or None, default=None) – Minimum cluster size in voxels.

  • cut_coords (list or tuple, length 3, default=(6, 6, 6)) –

    Cut coordinates for x, y, and z displays.

    Each element can be an int, float, list, tuple, or None. If an element is None or 0, that display direction is skipped.

  • background (Niimg-like object or str, default=get_bg_ch2bet()) – Background image.

  • vmin (float or None, default=None) – Color limits.

  • vmax (float or None, default=None) – Color limits.

  • cmap (str or matplotlib colormap, default="hot") – Colormap.

  • title (str or None, default="RSA Results") – Base plot title.

  • colorbar_label (str or None, default=None) – Colorbar label.

  • draw_cross (bool, default=True) – Whether to draw crosshair.

  • connectivity (int, default=1) – Connectivity used for cluster-size thresholding.

  • show (bool, default=True) – Whether to show the plot immediately.

Returns:

displays – Nilearn display objects for x, y, and z cuts.

Return type:

dict

neurora.rsa_plot.plot_ct_decoding_acc(acc, start_timex=0, start_timey=0, time_intervalx=0.01, time_intervaly=0.01, smooth=True, smooth_window=5, chance=0.5, p=0.05, cbpt=True, clusterp=0.05, stats_timex=None, stats_timey=None, xlim=None, ylim=None, clim=(0.4, 0.8), xlabel='Training Time (s)', ylabel='Test Time (s)', clabel='Decoding Accuracy', figsize=(6.4, 4.8), cmap='viridis', contour_color='silver', contour_linewidth=3, contour_linestyle='dashed', ticksize=12, fontsize=16, title=None, title_fontsize=16, n_iter=1000, show=True)¶

Plot cross-temporal decoding accuracies.

Parameters:

  • acc (array_like, shape [n_subs, n_tsx, n_tsy]) –

    Subject-level cross-temporal decoding accuracies.

    n_tsx is the number of training time points. n_tsy is the number of test time points.

  • start_timex (float, default=0) – Time of the first training time point.

  • start_timey (float, default=0) – Time of the first test time point.

  • time_intervalx (float, default=0.01) – Training-time interval between adjacent time points.

  • time_intervaly (float, default=0.01) – Test-time interval between adjacent time points.

  • smooth (bool, default=True) – Whether to smooth each subject’s cross-temporal matrix.

  • smooth_window (int, default=5) – Approximate Gaussian smoothing window in time points.

  • chance (float, default=0.5) – Chance level.

  • p (float, default=0.05) – Point-wise or cluster-forming p-value threshold.

  • cbpt (bool, default=True) – Whether to use cluster-based permutation test.

  • clusterp (float, default=0.05) – Cluster-level p-value threshold.

  • stats_timex (tuple or list of float or None, default=None) –

    Training-time window for statistical analysis.

    If None, the full training-time range is used.

  • stats_timey (tuple or list of float or None, default=None) –

    Test-time window for statistical analysis.

    If None, the full test-time range is used.

  • xlim (tuple or None, default=None) – Training-time axis limits.

  • ylim (tuple or None, default=None) – Test-time axis limits.

  • clim (tuple, default=(0.4, 0.8)) – Color limits.

  • xlabel (str, default="Training Time (s)") – X-axis label.

  • ylabel (str, default="Test Time (s)") – Y-axis label.

  • clabel (str, default="Decoding Accuracy") – Colorbar label.

  • figsize (tuple, default=(6.4, 4.8)) – Figure size.

  • cmap (str or matplotlib colormap, default="viridis") – Colormap.

  • contour_color (matplotlib color, default="silver") – Color of significance contour.

  • contour_linewidth (int or float, default=3) – Line width of significance contour.

  • contour_linestyle (str, default="dashed") – Line style of significance contour.

  • ticksize (int or float, default=12) – Tick label size.

  • fontsize (int or float, default=16) – Axis label size.

  • title (str or None, default=None) – Figure title.

  • title_fontsize (int or float, default=16) – Title font size.

  • n_iter (int, default=1000) – Number of permutations for cluster-based permutation test.

  • show (bool, default=True) – Whether to show the plot immediately.

Returns:

ps – Binary significance map.

Return type:

ndarray, shape [n_tsx, n_tsy]

neurora.rsa_plot.plot_rdm(rdm, percentile=False, lim=(0, 1), conditions=None, con_fontsize=12, cmap=None, title=None, title_fontsize=16, colorbar_label=None, colorbar_fontsize=16, show_values=False, value_fontsize=10, value_format='.4f', value_color='blue', figsize=None, show=True)¶

Plot a representational dissimilarity matrix (RDM).

Parameters:

  • rdm (array_like, shape [n_cons, n_cons]) – Representational dissimilarity matrix.

  • percentile (bool, default=False) – Whether to display RDM values as percentile ranks.

  • lim (tuple of float or None, default=(0, 1)) –

    Color limits.

    If None, matplotlib determines the limits automatically.

  • conditions (list of str or None, default=None) – Condition labels.

  • con_fontsize (int or float, default=12) – Font size of condition labels.

  • cmap (matplotlib colormap or str or None, default=None) –

    Colormap.

    If None, “jet” is used.

  • title (str or None, default=None) – Figure title.

  • title_fontsize (int or float, default=16) – Font size of the title.

  • colorbar_label (str or None, default=None) –

    Colorbar label.

    If None, a default label is used.

  • colorbar_fontsize (int or float, default=16) – Font size of colorbar tick labels and label.

  • show_values (bool, default=False) – Whether to show numerical values inside RDM cells.

  • value_fontsize (int or float, default=10) – Font size of displayed cell values.

  • value_format (str, default=".4f") – Format string for displayed values.

  • value_color (str, default="blue") – Color of displayed values.

  • figsize (tuple or None, default=None) – Figure size.

  • show (bool, default=True) – Whether to show the figure immediately.

Returns:

  • fig (matplotlib.figure.Figure) – Figure object.

  • ax (matplotlib.axes.Axes) – Axes object.

neurora.rsa_plot.plot_tbyt_decoding_acc(acc, start_time=0, time_interval=0.01, smooth=True, smooth_window=5, chance=0.5, p=0.05, cbpt=True, clusterp=0.05, stats_time=None, color='r', xlim=None, ylim=(0.4, 0.8), xlabel='Time (s)', ylabel='Decoding Accuracy', figsize=(6.4, 3.6), x0=0, labelpad=0, ticksize=12, fontsize=16, markersize=2, title=None, title_fontsize=16, avgshow=False, n_iter=1000, show=True)¶

Plot time-by-time decoding accuracies with statistical results.

Parameters:

  • acc (array_like, shape [n_subs, n_ts]) – Subject-level time-by-time decoding accuracies.

  • start_time (float, default=0) – Time of the first data point.

  • time_interval (float, default=0.01) – Time interval between adjacent data points.

  • smooth (bool, default=True) – Whether to smooth each subject’s time course.

  • smooth_window (int, default=5) – Approximate smoothing window in time points.

  • chance (float, default=0.5) – Chance level.

  • p (float, default=0.05) – Point-wise or cluster-forming p-value threshold.

  • cbpt (bool, default=True) – Whether to use cluster-based permutation test.

  • clusterp (float, default=0.05) – Cluster-level p-value threshold.

  • stats_time (tuple or list of float or None, default=None) –

    Time window for statistical analysis.

    If None, the full time range is used.

  • color (matplotlib color, default="r") – Plot color.

  • xlim (tuple or None, default=None) – X-axis limits. If None, uses the full time range.

  • ylim (tuple, default=(0.4, 0.8)) – Y-axis limits.

  • xlabel (str, default="Time (s)") – X-axis label.

  • ylabel (str, default="Decoding Accuracy") – Y-axis label.

  • figsize (tuple, default=(6.4, 3.6)) – Figure size.

  • x0 (float, default=0) – X position of y-axis spine.

  • labelpad (int or float, default=0) – Y-label padding.

  • ticksize (int or float, default=12) – Tick label size.

  • fontsize (int or float, default=16) – Axis label size.

  • markersize (int or float, default=2) – Significant marker size.

  • title (str or None, default=None) – Figure title.

  • title_fontsize (int or float, default=16) – Title font size.

  • avgshow (bool, default=False) – Whether to show the mean curve line.

  • n_iter (int, default=1000) – Number of permutations for cluster-based permutation test.

  • show (bool, default=True) – Whether to show the plot immediately.

Returns:

ps – Binary significance vector.

Return type:

ndarray, shape [n_ts]

  • title (str or None, default=None) – Figure title.

  • nonsig_linewidth (int or float, default=1) – Line width for non-significant time points.

  • nonsig_alpha (float, default=0.8) – Alpha for non-significant dashed lines.
